purpose: Define reference pattern separating expected validation findings/results from exceptional toolchain execution failures.

owns: Python Error and Result Model semantics

topics.name: Python Error and Result Model
topics.purpose: Define reference pattern separating expected validation findings/results from exceptional toolchain execution failures.

semantics.finding_rule: Invalid user/repository content produces structured findings/results.
semantics.boundary_rule: Exceptions are caught at stage/CLI boundaries and converted to explicit run error evidence.
semantics.trace_rule: Internal traceback is diagnostic and not canonical finding identity.
semantics.exit_rule: CLI maps result/error classes deterministically to exit status.

invariants.rule: Toolchain code, scans, indexes, reports and generated artifacts remain implementation/evidence surfaces; they never become canonical semantic authority unless an explicit accepted canonical definition says so.
Every toolchain execution binds exact bootstrap/source/profile/input revisions and must not resolve ambiguity through filesystem order, newest-wins, mtime, fuzzy names or UI layout.

hard_gates.condition: all findings thrown as generic exceptions
